name: Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges with Garlicky Parsley-Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and cut each sweet potato lengthwise into 6-8 wedges, depending on size, then divide between two baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping halfway through, until potatoes are golden brown and fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a blender. (Alternatively, you can prepare the sauce using a food processor.)
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Peel garlic. Add to the blender along with tahini, water, and salt. Blend on high until smooth, adding additional water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
½ cup tahini
⅓ cup water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide sweet potato wedges between plates. Serve with tahini sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
